mode: same-input offline snapshot replay, no live collection

checks.explanation: Skill deduplicates representative quotes by record_key; original repeated reviews under different themes.

checks.name: fresh_report_validation

normalization: Only evidence paths relocate. Compare original paths with origin_* fields and compare actual evidence file hashes. All other original fields compare exactly, without rounding or dropping comments.

representative_quotes.explanation: Skill deduplicates representative quotes by record_key; original repeated reviews under different themes.

html.reason: Reusable report template, evidence paths and manual review notes differ.

expected_differences.data_files: Added provenance and relocated raw evidence paths change CSV/JSON/workbook bytes; source comment values and labels are compared semantically above.
expected_differences.qa_schema: Equivalent window QA fields have renamed columns; original full-history QA is outside the new window QA scope.
expected_differences.monthly_schema: Skill stores app-level monthly metrics in nested JSON and CSV; compare equivalent monthly counts and rates plus independently recalculated app metrics.

validation_sample_order.reason: Original sample is newest first; Skill groups the same ten comments by app and rating.

limits: No fresh crawling or current website validation.
Original language labels are reused; language detection is not rerun.
Deterministic rule reproducibility does not establish sentiment/theme accuracy.
The 10-comment spot-check is performed by the agent, not an independent annotator.
